book.description:
Bakit namamalo si Miss Uyehara?
May mga notebook bang lumilipad?

Saan ang Ganges River sa Pilipinas?

No calculators.
No dictionaries.
No erasures.
No cheating.

Oops, time's up!
Pass your papers.
